bsSubtitle: Find a booking by reference, number, name or email, then help whoever needs it.
bsSearchPlaceholder: Reference (KB-…), booking number, name or email
bsSearchFailed: Search didn’t work just now. Please try again.
bsNoResults: No bookings match that. Check the spelling or try the reference.
bsCaseFailed: We couldn’t load this booking right now.
bsCalcWhenAmount: Calculated when you enter an amount
bsFlag_manual_hold: Manual hold (refunds and kitchen payments paused)
bsNoActions: Nothing can be done on this booking right now.
bsNeedsAttention: An earlier support action is still in progress or needs checking. Look at the history before doing anything else.
bsTransferNote: “Recorded” means we have it in our books. It does not confirm a bank payout.
bsLedgerNotVerified: These figures come from our records and haven’t been checked against the payment provider.
bsNoVisitCodes: This booking has no visit codes.
bsCodeDigitsNever: The code digits are never shown here.
bsEvidenceUnavailable: We couldn’t load payment details. Refresh in a moment, and don’t treat any payment figure as confirmed until they load.
bsChronologyFilter: Filter by where it came from
bsAction_cancel_kitchen_caused: Cancel because the kitchen cannot host
bsAction_accept_cancellation_for_manager: Accept the cancellation for the kitchen
bsAction_goodwill_refund: Send a Local Cooks goodwill refund
bsDialogIntro: Booking {reference}. This is recorded with your name.
bsRequestSource: How did this request reach us?
bsSourceRefPlaceholder: For example, a call date or ticket link
bsReason_no_response_from_manager: The kitchen didn’t reply in time
bsReason_kitchen_could_not_serve: The kitchen can’t host this booking
bsReason_service_recovery: Making things right after a bad experience
bsReason_arrival_problem: A problem arriving at the kitchen
bsInternalNote: Internal note (only Local Cooks sees this)
bsInternalNoteHint: What happened and why you’re doing this. At least 10 characters.
bsSharedMessage: Message shared with the chef and kitchen (optional)
bsSharedMessageHint: Shared with the chef and kitchen. Both will read it, so keep it kind and factual. At least 10 characters if you add one.
bsSharedMessageSelfHint: Required for self check-in, 10 to 500 characters. Shared with the chef and kitchen.
bsQuoteNote: The chef would receive {amount} back. The kitchen sees the same figure.
bsModeStaffed: Kitchen staff let them in (visit code)
bsActualAtHint: Enter the time in {zone}, the kitchen’s own time.
bsConfirmAbsent: I’ve confirmed the chef was absent for this visit.
bsClaimDescriptionHint: At least 50 characters. This is a draft concern for review; it doesn’t charge the chef.
bsResendForce: Send again even though it was already delivered
bsPvUnverified: This is an estimate. It hasn’t been confirmed with the payment provider.
bsExceptionQuestion: This is above the {limit} goodwill limit. Record as an exception?
bsExceptionBody: It will be saved as an exception under your name, with your note. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
bsErrReasonOther: Please describe the reason in a few words.
bsErrMessageShort: A shared message needs at least 10 characters, or leave it empty.
bsErrMessageShort500: Keep the message between 10 and 500 characters.
bsErrSelfMessage: Explain why self check-in is approved, in 10 to 500 characters.
bsErrChooseTarget: Choose a visit that can still be changed.
bsErrConfirmAbsent: Please confirm the chef was absent.
bsErrClaimTitle: Give it a title of 5 to 200 characters.
bsErrAmount: Enter an amount in dollars, like 12.50.
bsErrAmountMax: That is more than can be refunded on this booking.
bsErrNoQuote: There’s no current cancellation quote, so this can’t be accepted yet. Refresh the booking.
bsErrInvalid: Something in the form isn’t right. Please check it and try again.
bsErrNetwork: We couldn’t reach the server, so we don’t know whether this went through. Try again: it won’t be done twice.
bsErrServerGeneric: Something went wrong. Refresh the booking before trying again.
bsRetryLocked: The form is locked so a retry is exactly the same request.
bsResult_failed_body: The booking below is up to date. Look at what changed before deciding whether to try again. A new attempt starts fresh.
bsResult_recovery_required_body: Please don’t try again yet. The booking is marked for checking. Look at the payment in the Stripe Dashboard and refresh this booking before doing anything else.
bsResult_executing_body: This is still in progress. Refresh the booking in a minute before doing anything else.
bsResultReplayed: This had already been recorded, so nothing new was done.
bsFeedbackNotOpen: Feedback opens when the booking closes.
bsFeedbackFailed: We couldn’t load feedback right now.
